title: General Material Blend 3-Mix Duo #29 (부채꼴·물결 / 세로 띠·물결 | 이레즈미+스테인드글라스+뱀비늘 / 공작눈무늬+인어비늘+이레즈미)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Chinese, in her mid 20s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in a classic French braid from the crown, real pores, real living eyes, 8 clicker rings piercings set with amethysts in bronze-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of mixed-metal a bracelet. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 45% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 2 o'clock, 5 o'clock and 9 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 2 o'clock ray and the 5 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, hannya mask formations in CRIMSON and STARK GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the wedge between the 5 o'clock ray and the 9 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 3 is the wedge between the 9 o'clock ray and the 2 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING DEEP EMERALD scale formations, VIVID JADE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Italian, in her late 50s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a defined edge, a smouldering, confident expression, pure icy-white hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real pores, real living eyes, 3 hoops piercings set with sapphires in copper-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a hair ornament. Fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 41% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 79% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries peacock feather-eye markings (overlapping feather-barb ridges each converging into a round eye-marking with a raised rim), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD eye-marking centres, VIVID DEEP BLUE radiating barb-ridge detail, every marking standing in true relief. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries mermaid scales (fine delicate scales, small and closely overlapping with a soft iridescent sheen), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID PEARL scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, chrysanthemum formations in DEEP GOLD and EMERALD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: both hands sweeping her hair back, her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
